THE ARMED FORCES (EMERGENCY DUTIES) ACT, 1947.
ACT No. XV of 1947
[20th March,
1947]
An Act to enable duties in connection with vital services to be imposed
in an emergency on the Armed Forces of [Subs. by A.
O., 1961, Art. 2 and Sch., for the Crown (with effect from the 23rd March,
1956).] [Pakistan].
1. Short title and extent. ‑.(1) This Act may be called the
Armed Forces (Emer gency Duties) Act, 1947.
[Subs. by
the Central Laws (Statute Reform) Ordinance, 1960 (21 of 1960), s. 3 and 2nd
Sch. (with effect from the 14th October, 1955), for the original sub‑section
(2), as amended by A. O., 1949.] [(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.]

Emergency duties of Armed Forces

THE ARMED FORCES (EMERGENCY DUTIES) ACT, 1947
THE ARMED FORCES (EMERGENCY DUTIES) ACT, 1947.
ACT No. XV of 1947
[20th March,
1947]
An Act to enable duties in connection with vital services to be imposed
in an emergency on the Armed Forces of [Subs. by A.
O., 1961, Art. 2 and Sch., for the Crown (with effect from the 23rd March,
1956).] [Pakistan].
2. Emergency duties of Armed
Forces.‑(1) The Central Government may, by notification [For such notification, see Gaz. of P., Ext., 1950, p. 125.]
in the official Gazette, declare any specified service to be a service of vital
importance to the community:
Provided that
such notification shall remain in force for one month in the first instance,
but may be extended, from time to time, by a like notification.
(2) Upon a declaration being made
under sub‑section (1) and until it is rescinded, it shall be the duty of
every person subject to the Indian Army Act, 1911 [Ins.
by Ord. 21 of 1960, s. 3 and 2nd Seh. (with effect from the 14th
October, 1955).]
[or the Pakistan Army Act, 1952], or the Indian Air Force Act, 1932 [Ins. by Ord. 21 of 1960, s. 3 and 2nd Seh. (with effect from
the 14th October, 1955).] [or the Pakistan Air Force Act,
1953], or the [Subs. by the Repealing and Amending
Ordinance, 1965 (10 of 1965), s. 3 and 2nd Sch., for Naval Discipline Act, in
the form in which it is set forth in the First Schedule to the Pakistan Navy
(Discipline) Act, 1934 , (with effect from the 1st March, 1962).]
[Pakistan Navy Ordinance, 1961], to obey any command given by any superior
officer in relation to employment upon or in connection with the service
specified in the declaration; and every such command shall be deemed to be a
lawful command within the meaning and for the purposes of the said Acts [Added by the Repealing and Amending Ordinance, 1965 (10 of
1965), s. 3 and 2nd Sch. (with effect from the 1st March, 1962).]
[or Ordinance]. VIII of 1911. XIV of
1932.
